justifications.unit: Unit tests drive VerifyAsync, VerifyProviderAsync and the consumer builder on real Pact files and handlers; the remainder is the ReflectionTypeLoadException path and #1917-affected mappings left untested on purpose (#2650).
justifications.guard: Guard tests reach the argument checks, including after valid configuration, and the setup lines they pass through (measured 19.6 % on 2026-10-22); the verifier, matching and mock-server code is not argument validation, and the internal XunitOutputAdapter is not visible to Encina.GuardTests (#2650).

justifications.unit: Unit tests drive the builder, the failure expectations and the category-based status mapping through real Pact files; left uncovered are the mock-server error branches that the integration flag exercises.
justifications.guard: The guard flag reaches the argument checks and the setup lines they pass through; mock-server interaction and status mapping run in the unit and integration flags.

justifications.unit: Unit tests run the verifier on real Pact files and handlers, including the category-based status mapping; left uncovered are the ReflectionTypeLoadException and rare transport-failure branches.
justifications.guard: The guard flag reaches only the argument checks and the configuration setup; verification, matching and status mapping run in the unit flag.
